title: Create no-op tool for synthetic injection
description:
Create ensure_tool_call_compliance tool that executes without errors and produces no visible output. Register in ToolRegistry.

## Story Context
- **Story:** Story 1: Create No-Op Tool
- **Purpose:** Provide fallback tool for synthetic injection when LLM produces zero tool calls
- **Contributes To:** FR3 (No-op tool exists and executes without errors)

## File Scope
- **Creates:** packages/opencode/src/tool/ensure-compliance.ts
- **Modifies:** packages/opencode/src/tool/registry.ts (register new tool)

## Implementation
Location: packages/opencode/src/tool/ensure-compliance.ts
Pattern: Model after InvalidTool (Effect-based)
Returns empty output, no user-facing content

## Verification
- Unit test: Tool executes without throwing errors
- Unit test: Tool returns empty/no-op output
- Tool appears in ToolRegistry.layer
